correctness.rationale: After centering the fixed data, the Bayesian-bootstrap mean is a Dirichlet linear form A and the weighted variance is B-A^2. value.rationale: Weighted mean and weighted variance are two basic functionals propagated by the Bayesian bootstrap. Their joint posterior uncertainty matters when location and dispersion are reported together. The exact covariance reveals that posterior location-dispersion dependence is controlled solely by empirical third central moment, while the exact dispersion variance uses only empirical second and fourth moments. This is a finite-sample diagnostic rather than an asymptotic approximation or a simulation recipe.
